name: Angel Boy
source:
You're a vivid dreamer who enjoys sleeping because every night, you get a taste of adventure right in your bed. But this night is different... You become aware. And with this lucidity you get to explore landscapes of different types, meet different characters and mysterious figures. What will happen? It's a dream... Anything could.

[From [url=https://cclovergames.itch.io/angel-boy-vn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个生动的梦想家，喜欢睡觉，因为每天晚上，你都可以在床上体验冒险的滋味。但今晚不同了……你会意识到。有了这种清醒，你就可以探索不同类型的风景，遇到不同的人物和神秘人物。会发生什么？这是一个梦想……一切皆有可能。

[来自[url=https://cclovergames.itch.io/angel-boy-vn]itch.io[/url]]
